renderer.PREDICT_UPDATE: Before another action, state one falsifiable prediction about its public outcome. If the outcome contradicts it, identify one causal assumption you are narrowing before choosing the next action.
renderer.DISCRIMINATE: Keep two live explanations. Choose a legal action whose possible public outcomes would distinguish them. The action is yours to choose.
renderer.SCOPE: Keep the current belief local to its cited evidence. Promote it only after support from a distinct task; narrow or retract it after contrary public evidence.
renderer.NO_CORRECTION: Continue using only public evidence. Decide for yourself what to test, revise, or retain.

parent_runtime.neutral_matching: At the separately authorized tokenizer gate, enumerate concatenations of 1 through 32 entries from neutral_renderer_vocabulary, order candidates lexicographically by their UTF-8 bytes, and choose the first candidate that exactly matches role and token count. If no candidate matches within 96 tokens, return TOKEN_MATCH_NO_GO before scientific identities exist. No wording may be invented after this proposal.

pilot.adverse_rule: every one of D, W_P, and L_terminal in every pilot root must be at least -1/20
pilot.advance_rule: all four roots pass validity and resource gates; no adverse crossing; at least three roots have D>0 AND W_P>0 AND L_terminal>0 jointly; exact-rational means of all three quantities are >0
pilot.numeric_law: reduce canonical integer counts to exact rationals; denominator positive; signed zero canonicalizes to 0/1 and is not positive; missing, nonfinite, duplicate, noncanonical, or unreduced input yields NO_ADVANCE
pilot.missingness: any absent committed primary cut, failed root validity, or administrative missingness yields NO_ADVANCE; roots are retained and never retried or replaced
pilot.blinding: pilot_decision_manifest is computed and hash-committed before any detailed writer-path receipt is unsealed to the analyst or human spender

q_support.programs: canonical enumeration of the hash-bound eligible CompilerGym universe; reject aliases/collisions; keyed permutation; first 56 unique valid programs without replacement, first 48 wake and last 8 probe
q_support.nursery: canonical candidate enumeration under the two inherited generator families; keyed permutation; first 12 structurally valid matched opportunity packets, each with source and fresh homologous application tasks, yielding 24 unique tasks per P/U branch
q_support.exhaustion: fewer than 56 unique eligible programs or 12 matched nursery opportunities is Q_SUPPORT_INVALID before root execution; do not retry, substitute, or change the universe
q_support.root_independence: roots draw independently with replacement from Q using the inherited HMAC/PCG64DXSM counter-key law; P/U and five-service within-root coupling remains exact
